chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād and Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd Allāh, who said:
I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about the ghusl of Friday, and he said: “It is obligatory upon every male and female, whether slave or free.”

key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, the occasion of the prescribed ghusl

ai.seo_question: Is the Friday ghusl obligatory for every Muslim, including women and slaves?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام concerning the Friday ghusl. It states the obligation of this ghusl in universal terms, applying to men and women alike, whether enslaved or free.
